# sdd-kit-drupal

Drupal 11 add-on: drupal-11 skill with module scaffolding.

- Version: 2.1.1
- Keywords: drupal, php

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add stasmarkov/sdd-kit
/plugin install sdd-kit-drupal@sdd-kit
```
